receipt.postedSubtitle: The amount below was credited to the account.
receipt.pendingSubtitle: Received at the branch — NOT yet credited.
receipt.postedNote: This receipt confirms a posting in the simulated banking system of the sandbox.
receipt.pendingNote: This is an acknowledgment that the item was received. It does not confirm that funds were credited. A cheque is credited only after it clears.
receipt.footer: Sandbox document with synthetic data — not an official bank certificate.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Customers who pay you at a branch using their customer code.
customers.caption: Customers
customers.name: Name
customers.emptyHint: Register a customer to give them a code for branch deposits.
customers.codeHint: Unique within your company. It cannot change once a deposit or invoice uses it.
customers.noManage: You can view customers but not change them.
customers.importDeferred: Importing customers from a file is not part of this release.

customer.archiveHelp: An archived customer keeps its history but can no longer receive deposits. A customer with open invoices cannot be archived.

invoices.title: Invoice references
invoices.help: A reference to collect against — not a tax or accounting invoice. Paid status comes from allocated deposits only.
invoices.caption: Invoice references
invoices.amountHint: In LYD, up to three decimals.
invoices.allocateHelp: Match part of a posted deposit of this customer to an invoice. You cannot allocate more than is left of the deposit or more than is due.
invoices.nothingToAllocate: There is no posted deposit with a remaining amount, or no open invoice.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.description: Cash and cheques your customers paid in at a branch.
deposits.caption: Deposits

help.PENDING_MANAGER: Waiting for a branch manager. Nothing has been credited.
help.ACCEPTED_PENDING_CLEARING: The cheque was accepted. It is credited only after it clears.
help.RETURNED: The cheque was returned. Nothing was credited.
help.REJECTED: The deposit was not accepted. Nothing was credited.
help.STATUS_UNKNOWN: The bank is confirming the result of the posting. Do not assume it was credited or failed.
help.CANCELLED: Cancelled before posting. Nothing was credited.
